description: Aeon trust boundaries. Each crossing defines permitted input, required identity, validation, size/resource limits, failure behaviour, audit requirement, and whether data may influence model state or operational authority.

boundaries.name: corpus_ingestion
boundaries.permitted_input: text records (.txt/.jsonl/dir); UTF-8; per-record size <= 1 MiB
boundaries.required_identity: corpus source manifest with signed origin/license/hash
boundaries.validation: aeon.data.iter_text_records + F2 corpus manifest gate; unidentified sources rejected

boundaries.name: tokenizer
boundaries.validation: AeonTokenizer(...) constructor; F3 strict_load metadata cross-check

boundaries.name: training_process
boundaries.permitted_input: YAML config file + tokenizer + corpus paths (operator-signed)
boundaries.validation: E1 config-invariant tests + F2 provenance verification

boundaries.name: model_runtime
boundaries.required_identity: process runtime identity + F4 execution identity
boundaries.validation: tensor dtype + shape checks; no arbitrary code from input; bounded output_bound

boundaries.name: recursion_state
boundaries.permitted_input: s, t, h, c, e tensors from within the same forward call
boundaries.validation: fp32 dtype invariant; certificate audit; structural cadence check

boundaries.name: key_management
boundaries.permitted_input: opaque key handle (reference only, never key material)
boundaries.validation: handle resolvable via operator-configured KDF or KMS; keys never touch disk in cleartext

boundaries.name: operator
boundaries.permitted_input: signed operator decision (F5) including authorization reference
boundaries.validation: F5 state-transition rules; deterministic authorization outside the model

boundaries.name: evaluation
boundaries.permitted_input: held-out data + tokenizer identity matching training
boundaries.validation: F2 partition-leakage check; F6 evaluation-contamination test

boundaries.name: network
boundaries.validation: F4 network policy verified: no outbound client in aeon/, no urllib/requests/socket usage in training paths

boundaries.name: filesystem
boundaries.permitted_input: reads from read-only allowlist; writes to out_dir + metrics + audit

boundaries.name: update
boundaries.permitted_input: signed update package with new source_commit + policy_hash
boundaries.required_identity: operator signing key (out of Aeon's TCB)
boundaries.validation: F2 provenance: signature verify by operator; strict_load rejects when patch_manifest_version drifts

boundaries.name: recovery
boundaries.permitted_input: operator-signed recovery decision + selected .prev / recovery artefact identity
boundaries.validation: F3.3 authorized rollback record with all fields present

boundaries.name: manufacturing_interface
boundaries.permitted_input: structured telemetry frames from operator-approved ingress; analytical only
boundaries.validation: F5 freshness + sequence + authenticity checks; ANALYTICAL only

boundaries.name: communications_interface
boundaries.validation: F5 sequence continuity, replay indicators, freshness; ANALYTICAL only

boundaries.name: audit
boundaries.permitted_input: structured audit event from Aeon internal producers only
boundaries.validation: F3 hash chain: prev_hash + seq must be monotone
